subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Synthetic Identity Fraud
description: Learn Synthetic Identity Fraud in one minute.

hook.text: Why steal an identity when you can build one from scratch? That's synthetic identity fraud.

buildup.text: Fraudsters combine a real Social Security number with a fake name and birthday.

discovery.text: They slowly build credit for this fictional person — applying for cards, making payments on time.

twist.text: After months of good behavior, they max out every credit line and disappear completely.

climax.text: Synthetic fraud costs lenders billions annually and is the fastest-growing type of identity crime.

punchline.text: The most dangerous identity thief invents a person.

quiz.question: What is synthetic identity fraud?
options: Combining real and fake data to create a new identity
Using AI to generate fake IDs
